Fact panel, prose/fact: 'LOCATION: Casablanca Finance City, adjacent to CFG Bank' (the location is already published; 'adjacent to CFG Bank' WITHHELD: a neighbouring institution likely tied to the client, client names are not published), 'AREA: 10 m²' (WITHHELD, ledger C02: the site gives 38 m² and the plan's own dimensions contradict 10 m²; no surface figure is published), 'TYPE: Guard Pavilion – Human-scale security kiosk' (consistent with the published type 'Guard Pavilion'), 'YEAR: December 2024' (consistent with 2024). 'ABOUT: A sculpted sentinel of perforated steel, Sentry stands at the crossroads of civic rigor and poetic restraint. Its latticed walls filter sunlight into shifting filigree, transforming a humble kiosk into a beacon of watchful elegance.' Not published: 'perforated steel' agrees with the site's 'perforated steel'; the rest is no fact the drawings show. Quotation 'Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.' — Leonardo da Vinci: another author's words, not published
